payload.purpose: Same policy parameters and native reduced-k execution as default_arms.json; dense identity/counters added for common-trajectory logical-byte denominator.
payload.counting: Quality execution forces native reduced-k counters on; no latency claim.

scope: rolling teacher-forced decode PPL/KL with reset context P..P+S-1; all scored positions are decode
aggregation: exp(sum token NLL / scored decode tokens); position zero excluded
kl_direction: KL(native || policy), full vocabulary, before forcing mask
normalization: preserve each installed router's renormalize flag and routing scale; decision gate fractions are normalized separately

text_construction.order: original parquet order, including empty rows

coverage.tail_policy: score the final short window without padding; never drop incomplete batches

rolling_input.scope: rolling teacher-forced decode PPL/KL with reset context P..P+S-1; all scored positions are decode
rolling_input.statistical_unit: windows of one ordered split token stream; not independent articles or system repetitions
rolling_input.prefill_bridge: token at score_start-1 is emitted by prefill and excluded; every score_start:score_stop prediction uses decode

statistical_unit: windows of one ordered split token stream; not independent articles or system repetitions
context_definition: P-1 engine prompt + one excluded prefill bridge; scored context lengths P..P+S-1
